summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the hypothesis that HBM and AI/HPC advanced packaging demand crowd out conventional memory backend capacity, creating second-order demand for OSATs, memory test providers, advanced packaging tools, probe/test interfaces, and backend automation suppliers. The strongest direct US-listed candidate is Amkor as a large independent OSAT. The underfollowed discovery lane includes suppliers that may benefit from higher advanced-packaging intensity even if they are not the headline CoWoS/HBM owners: Kulicke & Soffa, FormFactor, and Cohu. Current evidence is node-level and analogical rather than company-specific for most candidates; these names should enter Layer 1 as hypotheses requiring filing-level validation.
